newsitem.title: JAPAN: Qatar raises Nov crude price formula - traders.
newsitem.headline: Qatar raises Nov crude price formula - traders.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has raised its price formula for November-lifting Qatar Land crude oil by eight cents per barrel and that of November-lifting Qatar Marine by nine cents per barrel, traders in Tokyo said on Wednesday.

According to the QGPC formula, November Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 69 cents per barrel, which translated into $22.49 per barrel, and November Qatar Marine at Oman plus 62 cents per barrel, or $22.42 per barrel.
October Qatar Land was set at Oman plus 61 cents per barrel, or $23.11 per barrel, and October Qatar Marine at Oman plus 53 cents per barrel, or $23.03 per barrel.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman, issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Mines.
